name: rotten heart of yours
source:
What kind of cruel world forces a woman to contemplate which of two indescribable horrors would be more ideal?

[From [url=https://rombuffer.itch.io/rotheart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
究竟是怎样残酷的世界，才会迫使一个女人在两种难以名状的恐怖之间权衡哪一种更为理想？
